parts.text: All this was comparatively slow until , with the coming of science, the tempo was suddenly raised . with the coming / arrival / birth / advent / dawn / genesis of... 随着…的到来 the tempo 速度/节奏 Then knowledge began to be accumulated according to a systematic plan. be accumulated ...被积累 accord to 符合、一致.. The trickle became a stream: the stream has now become a torrent. 暗喻修辞 比喻知识的增长速度 Moreover, as soon as new knowledge is acquired , it is now turned to practical account. turn sth. to ... account 把…加以利用/使…有利可图 What is called 'modern civilization' is not the result of a balanced development of all man's nature, but of accumulated knowledge applied to practical life. balanced development 平衡发展 The problem now facing humanity is : What is going to be done with all this knowledge ? face a problem 面临一个问题 As is so often pointed out , knowledge is a two-edged weapon which can be used equally for good or evil . As is so often pointed out, ... 正如经常被指出的那样，… two-edged / double-edged + weapon / sword 双刃剑 good or evil 善与恶 As Sir Francis Bacon once pointed out, knowledge is power. Power can be used for good or evil; and since the genie that brings new knowledge is already out of the bottle, we must learn to direct the use of the resultant power rather than curse the genie or try to confine him. Gre写作范文 It is now being used indifferently for both. indifferently adv.冷淡地；漠不关心地；平庸地；相当差地 Could any spectacle, for instance , be more grimly whimsical than that of gunners using science to shatter men's bodies while, close at hand, surgeons use it to restore them? spectacle n. an impressive sight 景象/场面 “spect” = look 【词根】 gunner 炮手 rhetorical question 修辞疑问句(增强语气/激发思考) 蒙太奇(montage) 画面拼接剪辑，增强对比效果 We have to ask ourselves very seriously what will happen if this twofold use of knowledge, with its ever-increasing power, continues . ever-increasing 不断增加的
